lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are arranged in a multi-row grid posterior to the gills, with a distinctive quartet of primary nodes forming a non-equilateral quadrilateral in the central flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical pale bands intersect with horizontal carinae to form a lattice; primary blobs are localized at these intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges show a high-contrast luminance gradient (bright superior edge, shadowed inferior edge) running from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 6 to 8 identifiable high-intensity blobs, with a higher concentration along the anterior margin.
